figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Active site of the CYP725A4 in complex with taxadiene and alanine scanning results for residues within the substrate-binding pocket. (a)
2Fo-Fc electron-density map of TAX (taxadiene) and heme molecules. (b) Hydrophobic interaction between the TAX molecule and CYP725A4.
M123, W125, M133, F129, L225, F229, and H305 are crucial residues surrounding the substrate and key to the catalytic function of CYP725A4.
Residues, including S302, L303, T310, P373, V374, and P484, are noncrucial for the catalytic function. Key distances between the carbon C5 and
C20 with the iron atom are shown along. All molecules in the structure diagram are shown as stick models. The substrate and heme molecules are
colored green and cyan, respectively. Crucial and noncrucial residues are colored marine and brown, respectively. The figures were prepared in
PyMOL [Pymol: An open-source molecular graphics tool]. (c) GC-MS analysis of the oxidation of taxadiene by CYP725A4 and alanine scanning
mutants.
